mentions.name: BongBong
mentions.description: Retro tank shooter game inspired by Battle City (NES) and Dyna Blaster, combining retro graphics and explosions with realistic physics alongside map building and play with friends both locally and online. Built in Rust with Raylib, it compiles natively for Mac, Linux, and Windows, runs in the browser via WASM and on Apple iOS, with Android support planned so the game works across platforms.
mentions.source_excerpt: BongBong tank shooter game. My first game. I wanted to recreate a game that is kind of a mix between old Battle City (NES) and Dyna Blaster, which I used to play as a kid in the 90s. I wanted to have a game where you don't just have retro graphics and beautiful explosions with realistic physics, but I also wanted to capture map building and playing with your friends - locally and online.
mentions.author: otobrglez
